status: research deployment head; frontend not included; not physical-phone-tested

selection.outer: Original whole-fruit folds reused verbatim; no outer result selects deployment
selection.inner: 3-fold stratified unique-fruit; fit normalization and weights only within each training split
selection.objective: pooled inner OOF fruit balanced accuracy
selection.tie_rule: first candidate in fixed block, weight, C order
selection.exploratory: Existing outer scores were previously inspected; nested procedure is not a new untouched test set

score_units: per-recording softmax probabilities; mean probabilities per fruit; not calibrated physical ripeness probabilities

feature_contract.includes: feature-index selection + fitted scaler + linear logits + (durian only) softmax
feature_contract.excludes: waveform decoding, resampling and feature frontend; no raw-audio input
feature_contract.audio_contract: ffmpeg mono float32 16000Hz; 100Hz highpass impact detector; <=18 one-second windows (100ms pre,900ms post); whole-recording impact feature mean/std

limits: 133 iPhone recordings/fruits after original ambiguity, contradictory-duplicate, terminal-stage and missing/disease-label exclusions; no reinstatement
Actual_Ripening_Status source labels; collection date, maturity stage and device may confound target; no new session/orchard validation
Not a universal fruit-ripeness or food-safety classifier
No physical iPhone test, mobile frontend conversion, latency, energy or memory measurement
Float32 builtin-only export numerically exercised on desktop; no FP16/int8 claim
